method.config_schema: Source fields use the current config schema: id, language, name, kind, url, and config. Config keys are limited to the generic archive/sitemap options accepted by zoofan.config and zoofan.discovery.
method.evidence_policy: Only official zoo/institution hosts and first-party endpoints are used. A source may be listed as disabled or registry_only when its page is official but direct fetching, host policy, or rendering evidence is insufficient.
method.robots_policy: A plan marked blocked, disabled, or registry_only must not be enabled as a crawl source until a normal robots-compliant Fetcher probe succeeds. No browser automation, robots bypass, or off-host PDF/API fallback is proposed.
method.pagination_policy: Archive max_pages is never greater than 2. Sitemap traversal is capped at max_sitemaps=2 (the configured root plus at most one child). A pagination selector is included only when an exact next-page link was observed in the fetched HTML; otherwise the plan is bounded to the verified first page and uses a sitemap fallback where available.

validation.config_schema_validation: passed in memory with all 29 plans
validation.css_selector_validation: passed for every executable archive/listing selector and proposed article-content selector
validation.endpoint_checks: Direct official HTTP probes and XML/HTML candidate counts are recorded per plan; blocked or no-candidate endpoints remain disabled.
validation.content_selector_live_retest: verified_live_retest for Prague, Burgers, and Copenhagen: exact source-scoped selectors passed bounded clean live runs; claims rely only on the recorded run evidence and preserve each source's narrow URL boundary.

global_gaps: No exact RSS or Atom endpoint was verified for any of the 10 rows; no RSS plan is invented.
No permitted public JSON API endpoint was verified. Blijdorp and Copenhagen robots disallow API paths; Beauval WordPress JSON is blocked/disallowed. Those paths are not proposed.
Tiergarten Schönbrunn has no verified sitemap/RSS/API source; its German HTML news and press archives are the active plans.
English listings are not always the most complete source: Prague sitemap fallback is Czech, Copenhagen news is Danish, and Zoo Zürich's German archives are substantially fuller than English.

Beauval's Actus sitemap index requires a second post child for article candidates; with the executable max_sitemaps=2 cap, that fallback is disabled after the first child yields no article candidates.
